push_to_hub_fastai: push a fastai Learner model to the Hugging Face Hub with optional config and file filtering
from_pretrained_fastai: load a pretrained fastai Learner model from the Hugging Face Hub or a local directory
save_pretrained_fastai: save a fastai Learner to a local directory in pickle format with model card and config
check_fastai_versions: check that installed fastai and fastcore versions meet minimum requirements for serialization
check_pyproject_versions: verify fastai and fastcore versions in pyproject.toml are compatible with from_pretrained_fastai
